chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Mu'awiyah ibn 'Ammar, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
The takbirs in the obligatory prayer, in the five prayers, are ninety-five takbirs; among them are five takbirs for the qunut.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرُ: the utterance of 'Allahu Akbar' within salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْقُنُوتِ: the qunut supplication position in salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: How many takbirs are there in the five daily obligatory prayers, including the qunut?
ai.summary: This hadith states the total number of takbirs in the five daily obligatory prayers and includes within that count the takbir associated with qunut. It serves as a juridical report concerning the structure of salat (prayer) and the place of qunut within the prescribed prayers.
